verdict.rationale: LlamaParse produces clean markdown/JSON/text output and mentions a separate 'Index' product for building hosted vector-search/RAG pipelines, implying some chunking capability, but the evidence never documents explicit semantic-boundary chunking, chunk-level metadata schemas, or embedding-ready segment formats as a first-class LlamaParse output. A community user even asks for basic page-number metadata in markdown output, suggesting such metadata isn't standard by default. missing for 10: documented chunking algorithm/semantic boundary logic, explicit chunk metadata schema (page, section, embeddings-ready fields), and evidence that Parse (not just the separate Index product) outputs pre-chunked segments.
